text:
sophie: FYI customer acme-inc reported high 429s and latency spikes around 12:30 UTC. They're on dedicated pool, tenant_id=acme-42. See logs: https://internal-logs.redwood/acme-42. Can obs team help map throttles->route/model->tenant? :eyes:
pranav: thanks, Sophie. Do we have a quick way to tell whether tokens are being throttled by route token_bucket vs global tenant quota?
maria: yes — two quick signals: rate_limit_denied metrics (labels: tenant_id, route, model_variant) and quota_burn_rate. I'd check prom query:
```
sum by(tenant_id, route, model) (rate(redwood_rate_limit_denied_total[5m]))
```
Also compare to:
```
sum by(tenant_id) (rate(redwood_tokens_consumed_total[5m]))
```
pranav: running that now, results show a spike for acme-42 on /v1/generate with model "gpt-small-qlf" around 12:28-12:35.
sophie: customer says they had a batch job that retried. Could retries cause runaway burst? :mag:
maria: yes — retries + short backoffs can blow through burst windows. Check per-route bucket level:
```
redwood_rate_limit_bucket_level{tenant_id="acme-42",route="/v1/generate"}
```
jay: can we correlate with console traces? If request id present we can check trace to see looped retries. Sophie, do you have a sample request id from the customer?
sophie: provided: req_20260317_88a7c. Pasting log snippet:
[log]
2026-03-17T12:29:01Z WARN rate_limiter: deny tenant=acme-42 route=/v1/generate tokens=512 bucket_fill=0.23 window=60
maria: perfect. I searched traces for req_20260317_88a7c — shows repeated attempts from same client over 90s. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/limits/tenant-acme-42
pranav: action items: 1) add alert that fires when rate_limit_denied_total per-tenant > 50 / 5m and correlating token burn > X, 2) show top 5 routes per tenant in the tenant dashboard, 3) add a quick "attribution" panel that groups by (route, model, api_key).
jay: I'll own the alert rule and add runbook steps to check for retries and abortive clients.
sophie: I'll update the customer: ask them to pause their batch and share headers for a repro.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: "limits-dashboard-update" to staging at 2026-03-17T13:05Z :white_check_mark:
maria: pushed a temp panel to staging showing denied counts by (route, model, api_key). Query used:
```
sum by (route, model_variant, api_key) (increase(redwood_rate_limit_denied_total[5m]))
```
pranav: looks good. Sophie, can you confirm customer paused? If yes we can close the ticket once we verify 429s drop.
sophie: confirmed paused at 12:50 UTC. 429s dropped to baseline by 12:57. I'll close once alert is in prod.
maria: will promote rule to prod tomorrow morning and ping this thread :white_check_mark:
sophie: thanks all :raised_hands:
